reasoning_content: Now mise install. This installs node, awscli, fnox, git-cliff, hk, jq, lychee, 1password-cli, glab, trivy. Note 1password-cli requires download from cache.agilebits.com. Let's try. This could take a while. 600s timeout.

action.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace && timeout 550 mise install 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
